description: Establish and record the green baseline for the VayuLok feature before any edit, so later features have a known-good reference. This is an existing project; confirm the gates pass on the freshly-cut branch vayulok-selected-place-final (from origin/stack tip 619a8793) with no code changes.
steps: Confirm git branch is vayulok-selected-place-final with `git branch --show-current` and that the working tree is clean.
Confirm node_modules is present; run `npm install` ONLY if it is missing or deps changed (deck.gl @deck.gl/core|google-maps|layers ^9.4.0 should already be installed).
Run `npm run typecheck` and confirm it exits clean.
Run `npm run lint` and confirm 0 errors (warnings are tolerated; baseline is ~203 repo-wide warnings, 0 errors).
Run `npx vitest run src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx` and confirm all 34 tests pass.
Record the baseline numbers (typecheck clean, lint 0 errors, 34 tests pass) in the feature findings so regressions are detectable.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run typecheck` exits 0 with no errors
`npx vitest run src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx` reports all tests passing (34 at baseline)
